summary: Structural follow-ups shipped: complete_task gains optional follow_ups [{title, prompt, when?, disruptive?}]. New lib/followups.js: validate() (400 on malformed before any state lands), apply() — each item becomes a graph task riding the SNAPSHOT substrate (key 'followup/<slug>-<rand>', description=prompt; never writes ~/.claude/tasks) + context edge parent→follow-up (parent summary = Tier-1 context). Routing: asap/past → derives ready (loop drains); future ISO when → not_ready override + one-time NATIVE scheduled task (SKILL.md + armed {fireAt,enabled} entry in the app's central registry at ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude-code-sessions/*/*/scheduled-tasks.json; registry missing ⇒ armed:false, arm manually); disruptive → severity-'review' guidance (never pauses loop) with action {kind:'follow-up', task_key}, task gated not_ready; /guidance/resolve approve releases to ready, reject cancels. daemon.js wires validate+apply into /overlay/status and the release hook into /guidance/resolve; mcp-core.js complete_task inputSchema documents the shape; README section added. Verified: node --check ×5, suite 33/33 (new test/followups.test.js, 36 asserts, temp-HOME for the writer), plus e2e on a scratch daemon :8899 (400s, ready/gated routing, context flow, approve-release). NOT live-tested: timed path against the real registry, and the running daemon predates the change — tonight's 01:30 restart activates this + the retention-sweep fix. Caveat (documented): daemon-written scheduled tasks carry no stored tool approvals → first unattended run may pause on permissions. Note: repo path is a symlink to ~/.claude/orchestrator, so repo=deployed inherently.

subject: Auto-schedule follow-ups: follow_ups field on complete_task
description: Add optional follow_ups: [{title, prompt, when?, disruptive?}] to the orchestrator's complete_task tool (lib/mcp-core.js:63 → POST /overlay/status in daemon.js). Daemon behavior per item: create a graph task wired with a context edge to the completed parent; when absent/"asap" → task is ready for the loop; when = ISO timestamp → also write a one-time native scheduled task (~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/{id}/SKILL.md); disruptive:true → do NOT auto-fire, queue via the existing escalation/guidance queue (POST /guidance, severity review). Update README. Orchestrator source is gated — /tmp+cp if blocked.
